'''Kaminoan electroeels''' were creatures that were native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. They tended to swim in swarms and give a dim glow underwater. Kaminoan electroeels were one of several [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Eel/Legends|eel]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Rebel Force: Firefight" />
